key_insight: WaVeFuse improves equity index forecasting by denoising noisy inputs, separating channel-specific time-frequency patterns, and adaptively fusing model branches as market regimes change.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a lightweight, deployable forecasting pipeline with strong accuracy, robust backtesting performance, and low inference latency for decision-support systems.
method: Symlet-4 wavelet denoising on OHLCV with MAD soft thresholding
Channel-wise continuous wavelet transform of seven technical indicators
CNN-BiLSTM and dual-layer Transformer fused by a 2-token Vertical Attention gate
evidence_signal: Walk-forward tests on KOSPI, DAX, NYSE Composite, and Russell 2000 (2010-2023) report R2 of 0.81-0.96, directional accuracy of 70.5-78.3%, and statistically significant gains over baselines (DM 4.62-10.38, p<0.001).
watch_item: Performance may depend on careful walk-forward tuning and realistic transaction-cost assumptions, so regime shifts and live-market slippage should be validated before deployment.
paper_title: WaVeFuse: Regime-Adaptive Equity Index Forecasting via Channel-Wise Wavelet Denoising and Vertical Attention Fusion
